title: `nvs.checkWorkspace` is promised by two rules and is neither contributed nor handled.
text: `rule:ide/check-scope-defaults-to-the-workspace` says `nvs.checkWorkspace` runs one workspace pass on demand without changing `nvs.check.scope`, and `rule:ide/contributions-are-frozen-and-only-ever-added` lists it among the frozen contributions. The command roster at `editors/vscode/package.json:195` does not contain it, `editors/vscode/src/extension.ts:115` registers no handler, and no code under `crates/nvs-lsp/src/` names it. Closing this contributes the command, has the server index the workspace once under `"open"`, and adds it to the roster test at `editors/vscode/test/contributions/contributions.test.ts:98`.
